n1.speaker: npc_thaumaturge
n1.text: Sorcery is paperwork with consequences. The Chancery issues it in grades. Grades cost obols. Obols cost souls.

spells.speaker: npc_thaumaturge
spells.text: Gilt Lance or Ember Brand. Each grade costs more: 20, then 45, then 90 obols.

body.speaker: npc_thaumaturge
body.text: Vitality for the claws, Focus for the mana. 15, then 35, then 70 obols.

bought_lance.speaker: npc_thaumaturge
bought_lance.text: There. Point it at things you dislike. Not at me.

bought_brand.speaker: npc_thaumaturge
bought_brand.text: Hotter now. Do not use it in the Records Annexe. Pell has a list.

bought_vitality.speaker: npc_thaumaturge
bought_vitality.text: Your soul is a little harder to tear. Congratulations, I suppose.

bought_focus.speaker: npc_thaumaturge
bought_focus.text: Breathe in. You do not need to, being dead. Do it anyway. Better.
